DMS_Stele.questDescriptionRules.rulesStr.li:
questDescription->With qubit decryption, our researchers can now pick up the faint authentication pulses of occultech glyphs: sealed cipher plates the colonial fleets dropped across this world. Each glyph carries one fragment of the key to a stele buried beneath this world, and the fleets scatter them so that no single find can open one.

Recover [keysCount] glyphs and bring them home. Reading a full set will resolve where the stele lies and how to break its seal. Glyph sites will surface over time, and the Legacy remnants assigned to them are still standing guard.

Once the stele is home, a decoder set flush against it will extract its knowledge.

DMS_SteleKey_ImpactSite.questDescription.li: questDescription->Our receivers have caught the authentication pulse of an occultech glyph. The fleets deliver glyphs to pioneer installations by orbital drop, and this capsule came in far too hard: it broke apart over the installation it was meant for and buried it in wreckage. The pioneers dug the glyph out of the debris and sealed it in a glyph server deep in the ruins. The Legacy remnants assigned to the site are still holding it.\n\nFind the glyph server and hack it to release the glyph, then bring the glyph home. Starting the hack will alert the whole garrison, and if the server is destroyed, the glyph goes with it. If we leave the glyph behind, it will be lost with the site.

DMS_SteleKey_ImpactSite.questContentRule.li: letterTextMapGenerated->Wreckage from the glyph capsule lies strewn across the ruined installation, and the remnants guarding it are still at their posts.\n\nThe glyph is sealed in the glyph server inside the ruins. Hacking it will alert the whole garrison. The glyph only counts once it is home.

DMS_SteleVault.questDescriptionRules.rul.li: questDescription(retry==False)->Our researchers have read the full set of occultech glyphs. The reading collapsed their quantum states and the glyphs are spent, but the cipher they held has resolved: a stele lies buried in a sealed vault at the marked location, still guarded by Legacy remnants.\n\n[vaultInstructions]

questDescription(retry==True)->The resolved glyph cipher still holds. With the last stele lost, it points to the next one: another sealed vault under Legacy guard, at the marked location.\n\n[vaultInstructions]
vaultInstructions->Clear the vault, claim the stele, uninstall it and bring it home. It weighs [steleMass] kg, so plan the transport. If we leave it behind, it will be lost with the site.

DMS_SteleVault.questContentRules.rulesSt.li: letterTextMapGenerated->The stele stands at the centre of the vault, and the remnants guarding it are already moving.\n\nOnce the area is clear, claim the stele and uninstall it. It must leave this site with us.
